## Current objective
Fix JPY rounding so `ledgerly/money.py` does not format JPY with two decimal places. PDF and avatar migrations are paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Sandbox: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is shut down and superseded. Use `structlog`, never `print()` or stdlib `logging`. Celery `visibility_timeout=6h` is superseded. Invoice report changes remain uncommitted.

## Ruled-out approaches
Six-hour Celery timeout concealed stuck duplicate jobs. Bare-list invoice responses break pagination; `limit=0` must remain HTTP 422.

## Plan and progress
Avatar steps 1–6 are done; 7–8 pending without a designated command. JPY inspection/implementation is pending. Next: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/money.py && rg 'JPY|format_money|currency' tests ledgerly/money.py -n`.

## Recent work
PDF renderer now includes negative lines, uses shared locale-aware formatting, and paginates consistently. Tests: `14 passed, 1 skipped`; billing: `83 passed, 4 skipped`; Ruff passed. `ruff format --check` was issued but has status unknown. Latest search found legacy session factories in `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, and `tests/conftest.py`.
